text:
Samuel: Quick async — handoff + remaining blockers for Dedicated capacity buildout. Need owners, milestones, and any risks for the next 2 weeks. tagging folks who touched this: @Maya @Lee @Priya
Maya: Hi — short status: procurement ETA from vendor is still 11 business days, shipping confirmation expected tomorrow. I asked for a tracking SLA update.
Lee: Rack and power work on schedule. Datacenter needs confirmation on ATS circuit by EOD Friday.
Priya: Provisioning plan ready. I still need the final SKU list to generate the reservation manifests.
Omar: From runtime side: can start canary images on emulated nodes next week, but we need KV cache sizing after we know actual GPU counts.
Samuel: Maya — can you paste the vendor ETA thread or just confirm date when you have it? Priya — SKU list required by Thu to hit next milestone.
Maya: Vendor replied in email: ETA 2027-06-04 (tentative). Filed ticket with procurement (#PRO-322). Will forward thread link in a bit.
Priya: Ok noted. If we get SKU by Thu I can produce manifests Mon-Wed next week and then hand to infra for staging.
Lee: Datacenter says ATS circuit appointment confirmed 2027-05-31 09:00-11:00 PT. I'll add the work order to the runbook.
Omar: Runtime dependency: need NFS mounts for model artifacts and an init script to populate KV cache. Pinged @eng-infra about a small PVC quota bump.
Samuel: Who owns the PR to wire the init script? I can assign review but want owner.
Priya: I'll own the PR for the manifests and the init-script stub. Will open PR and tag runtime for review. PR will reference infra ticket for PVC bump.
Lee: Infra will take the PVC bump ticket once you open it, Priya. FYI there is a maintenance window on 2027-06-02 evening, avoid scheduling heavy migrations then.
Maya: Shipping note: logistics asked if we can accept split deliveries (2 racks now, rest next week) — ok for SRE?
Omar: Split delivery is fine if we mark nodes as cordoned until full config applied. We will not advertise capacity until all racks in cluster are ready.
Samuel: Good. Risk callouts: 1) vendor delay (contingency: fallback SKU + extra quantized model variant) 2) ATS circuit miss (contingency: temporary cross-zone routing) 3) PVC quota timing (contingency: reduce cache footprint).
Priya: Timeline brief: SKU by Thu -> manifests by Mon -> infra staging Tue-Wed -> canary runtime Wed-Thu -> full ingress gating after successful 48h canary -> target soft-launch 2027-06-10.
Lee: I'll update the cluster ownership doc with staging owners and rotation for the first week post-launch.
Maya: I'll post the tracking link once I have the vendor confirmation.
Samuel: Two asks before I close this thread: 1) Priya, open the PR and tag @Omar + @Lee; 2) Maya, paste vendor tracking here when available. If anything slips, ping this thread. :thumbsup:
infra-bot: [ticket created] PRO-322 created by Maya: "H100 procurement - tracking & ETA"
Priya: PR opened: https://git.redwood/example/PR/4213 - description + manifests. tagging reviewers.
Omar: Reviewed PR comments left, nothing blocking — one small config nit (increase `kv_cache_size` by 10%).
Samuel: Thanks all. I'll follow up in next sync if any of the three risks change.
Maya: Vendor tracking posted: https://logistics.vendor/track/ZX-99877 - ETA updated 2027-06-03 now.
Lee: Added ATS confirmation and maintenance avoidance note to the runbook.
Priya: Noted Omar's kv_cache_size change and pushed a follow-up commit.
Omar: Confirmed, staging image booted locally with new init script. Will schedule a canary run Wed morning.
Samuel: Perfect. Closing loop — if you need any support from product or customer ops for rollout comms, ping me here. :rocket:
